_comment: Piece template registry. Each entry is a base archetype; RPG progression (upgrades, levels, skills) is layered on top per-instance -- see assets/data/upgrades/<id>.json and src/upgrades/SkillTree.h.

pieces.name: Recruit
pieces.description: A green foot soldier. Cheap, replaceable, and surprisingly deadly once it grows into its skill tree.

pieces.name: Vanguard
pieces.description: A mounted scout whose L-shaped charge ignores blockers entirely.

pieces.name: Mystic
pieces.description: A diagonal-striking spellcaster who trades raw power for support magic.

pieces.name: Guardian
pieces.description: A slow, heavily armored bulwark that holds the line along ranks and files.

pieces.name: Sovereign
pieces.description: The most versatile unit on the board: high mobility and high damage, but fragile if caught alone.

pieces.name: Monarch
pieces.description: Losing this piece ends the run. Slow and cautious, but its presence strengthens nearby allies.
